primitives.name: Lipid peroxidation free-radical chain (initiation-propagation) in post-TBI membranes
primitives.verbatim_quote: LP starts when a radical species, such as •OH, extracts hydrogen from an allyl group (AA + R• →AA• + RH), converting this allylic carbon into an “alkyl” radical (AA•). During the propagation stage, the resulting alkyl radical binds with a molecule of oxygen to form a lipid peroxyl radical (AA-OO•; AA• + O2 →AA-OO•). The peroxyl radical then reacts with a neighboring AA within the membrane and gains its electron to generate a lipid hydroperoxide (AA-OOH) and a resultant alkyl radical (AA•; AA-OO• + AA →AA-OOH + AA•)
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: AA = arachidonic acid (polyunsaturated membrane fatty acid, molecular species, count dimensionless); R• = initiating radical (e.g. •OH as printed), count dimensionless; AA• = lipid alkyl radical; RH = reduced initiator; O2 = molecular oxygen (concentration mol/L in kinetic reading); AAOO• = lipid peroxyl radical; AA-OOH = lipid hydroperoxide (product concentration mol/L). All three reactions are mass-balanced molecular transformations; no dimensional constants appear in the source notation. Chain-length amplification nu = R_p/R_i (propagation rate / initiation rate, both mol L^-1 s^-1, nu dimensionless) is a derived kinetic reading, NOT printed in the source.
primitives.assumptions: Printed context (Jarrahi et al., Biomedicines 2020, 8, 389, reprint p41, section 3.6): brain membranes are abundant in polyunsaturated fatty acids (arachidonic acid) extremely susceptible to •OH-induced peroxidation; initiation requires a radical species abstracting an allylic hydrogen; propagation assumes neighboring AA substrate available in the membrane and O2 present; the chain regenerates AA• each propagation cycle (self-sustaining until termination). Source frames this as secondary injury amplifying the primary mechanical insult. The chain-length nu formalization is standard chain-reaction kinetics applied to the printed mechanism, labeled derived.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Chain breaks when (a) antioxidant termination intercepts radicals - source lists GSH, GR, GST, GPx, CAT, SOD, uric acid as the endogenous neutralizing system (p38) and Nrf2-ARE upregulation as inducible defense (p42); (b) substrate depletion or membrane compartmentalization limits AA-OO• access to neighboring AA; (c) iron chelation removes Fenton-type •OH initiation (source section 3.3, p39); (d) therapeutic scavengers (tempol, PBN, phenelzine/PEH carbonyl scavengers, p41-42) truncate propagation or trap aldehyde end-products. The chain model also fails as a complete account where lipid peroxidation end-products (carbonyls) act as signaling species rather than pure damage - source notes LP carbonyls are trapped by hydrazines, implying reactive intermediates with their own chemistry.
timescales: tau_3: chronic LP sequelae and neurodegeneration (months-years)

layer2.mapping: Chain-reaction amplification operator: one initiation event produces nu >> 1 damaged units before termination. Isomorphic to cascading assignment failure in the 22-player football dynamical system: one broken coverage assignment (initiation) propagates through adjacent defenders (propagation, each radical defender creates the next mismatch) until a disciplined tackle/safety reset (termination). The invariant is the amplification ratio, not the substrate: damage per trigger = chain length. Constraint binding: termination capacity (antioxidant pool / assignment discipline) must exceed initiation rate or the cascade runs to substrate exhaustion (tissue loss / explosive play).
layer2.telemetry: Calibrating observables (no numeric values fabricated): peroxidation chain length nu from kinetic assays of O2 consumption vs radical initiation rate; in football, missed-tackle chain length and yards-after-contact per broken assignment from tracking data; in clinic, LP end-product carbonyls and 3-NT footprint (book pp39-42, p267). Source supplies mechanism and qualitative windows, not rate constants.

primitives.name: Two-stage ddPCR normalization: RNA-input quotient then geometric-mean endogenous-control quotient
primitives.verbatim_quote: The miRNA copies normalized to RNA input = (average miRNA copies/20 μL well)/(total RNA input to the 15 μL cDNA reaction) Next, the geometric mean (GM) of the RNA input-normalized copies from the 4 endogenous controls, miR-378a-3p, miR-3594-3p, miR-330-5p, and let-7b-3p, was cal- culated. Finally, the target miRNAs were normalized to the geometric mean of the 4 endogenous controls as follows: Normalized target miRNA copies = (miRNA copies normalized to RNA input)/(GM of RNA input normalized miRNA copies from 4 endogenous controls)
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C-bar_i = average miRNA copies per 20 uL well from 2 ddPCR replicates (dimensionless count); V_w = 20 uL well volume (volume); m_RNA = total RNA input to the 15 uL cDNA reaction (mass, e.g. ng), computed from NanoDrop concentration times the 1:100 dilution factor (p96); N_i = RNA-input-normalized copies (count/mass); c_k = the 4 endogenous controls miR-378a-3p, miR-3594-3p, miR-330-5p, let-7b-3p; N_c_k = their RNA-input-normalized copies (count/mass); geometric mean GM = (prod N_c_k)^(1/4) (count/mass); N-hat_i = final normalized target copies (dimensionless ratio). Both stages are dimensionally homogeneous quotients.
primitives.assumptions: Printed (Puhakka et al., Biomedicines 2022, 10, 136, reprint pp96-97): ddPCR gives absolute copy numbers (no standard curve); duplicate reactions averaged; RNA input variation is 'slight sample-to-sample' and multiplicative, so dividing by input mass removes it; the 4 endogenous controls are assumed stable across TBI/sham (selected from small RNA-Seq data as non-differentially-expressed); geometric mean (not arithmetic) aggregates controls, the standard choice when reference quantities vary multiplicatively. Same paper uses TMM normalization for sequencing counts (p95) and 2^-DeltaCt for miScript qPCR (p97, citing Livak & Schmittgen 2001).
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when (a) any endogenous control is itself regulated by the condition - the quotient then injects the biology it should remove (the paper's own isomiR analysis shows canonical-miRNA assumptions can mislead, p105); (b) RNA quality differs across groups - here guarded by RIN 8.9-9.2 and 260/280 2.01-2.10 (p94); (c) copy numbers approach the droplet Poisson detection floor where absolute counts become censored; (d) input-mass normalization cannot correct reverse-transcription efficiency differences between miRNAs (chemistry-dependent, TaqMan vs miScript). The geometric mean is undefined if any control count is zero.

layer2.mapping: Derived kernel: normalization as quotient by a multiplicative nuisance group. Each sample carries an unknown positive scale factor s (RNA input, RT efficiency, library depth); the observable is s*x. Dividing by input mass and then by the geometric mean of 4 invariant references projects the measurement onto the quotient space where s acts trivially - the same construction as TMM (trimmed mean of M-values, p95) and 2^-DeltaDeltaCt. In the 22-player system this is the gauge-fixing operator behind any rate statistic: per-snap, per-possession, per-minute normalization removes the nuisance opportunity-volume scale before comparing players/schemes; the geometric mean of stable references is the invariant-frame choice.
layer2.telemetry: Printed calibration: 4 endogenous controls (miR-378a-3p, miR-3594-3p, miR-330-5p, let-7b-3p); 20 uL well, 15 uL cDNA reaction, 1:100 RNA dilution; RIN 8.9-9.2, 260/280 2.01-2.10; n=6 TBI vs 6 sham; validated fold-changes miR-375-3p FC=3.44 (p<0.01), miR-211-5p FC=1.45 (p<0.05), miR-146a-5p FC=2.01, miR-155-5p FC=2.34 (p102). Football analog telemetry: snap counts, possession counts, minutes - the opportunity denominators.

primitives.name: Mechanical strain-dose regime map: 5% adaptive / 25% sublethal / 50% lethal in stretched neurons
primitives.verbatim_quote: The neurons were found to grow and survive with the rearrangement of cytoskeleton proteins, particularly microtubules, on being subjected to 5% strain. In addition, the aforementioned strain value enhanced the velocity of the synaptic vesicles. On the contrary, an aggressive strain, such as 50% [10], can change the MMP [11], release lactate dehydrogenase, and cause cell death [12,13].
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: epsilon = engineering strain = Delta L / L0 (dimensionless, m/m); Delta L = membrane elongation (m); L0 = resting membrane length (m); f = cyclic stretch frequency 1 Hz (s^-1); t = stretch duration 6 h or 24 h (h). Printed regime anchors: epsilon=0.05 (5%) -> survival, cytoskeleton/microtubule rearrangement, enhanced synaptic-vesicle velocity; epsilon=0.25 (25%) at 1 Hz -> MMP depolarization at 6 h (JC-1 green/red ratio up), 8-OHdG oxidative DNA damage and dopamine loss at 24 h, BDNF down, amyloid-beta/p-TauS396 up (pp74-79); epsilon=0.50 (50%) -> MMP change, LDH release, cell death (p73, citing prior studies). Regime map is a formalization of printed discrete strain levels, not a fitted continuous dose-response curve.
primitives.assumptions: Printed (Cheng et al., Biomedicines 2021, 9, 1650, reprint pp72-88): SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cells on collagen-coated PDMS, seeded 1.5x10^4/cm2, undifferentiated, 37 C / 5% CO2; severe stretch = rapid-onset strain pulse, 25% membrane deformation, 1 Hz, 6 and 24 h (p74). The 5% and 50% anchors are cited prior results (refs 9-13), not this paper's own measurements. Cell alignment scored at +/-30 degrees (p74). Statistics: Mann-Whitney U, mean +/- SEM, n>=3 independent runs (p75). The authors explicitly note SH-SY5Y is a proliferative cell line, 'entirely different from the terminally differentiated neurons' (p84).
primitives.breakdown_regime: Regime boundaries are model-dependent, not universal constants: (a) cell type - proliferative SH-SY5Y vs primary neurons shifts thresholds (authors' own limitation, p84); (b) the paper itself is internally inconsistent about stretch geometry - Methods says 'stretched in the biaxial direction' (p74) while Results repeatedly say 'uniaxial deformation/strain' (pp75-79): strain state (uniaxial vs biaxial) changes the stress tensor and thus the effective dose, so the regime map cannot be transferred without resolving this; (c) frequency and duration are confounded with strain amplitude - 25% at 1 Hz for 24 h is not interchangeable with a single 25% pulse; (d) in vivo neurons 'are not stretched' normally (p86) - the model is a mechanotransduction probe, not a literal replica of head impact.
timescales: tau_0: strain pulse onset (rapid, 1 Hz cycle)
tau_1: MMP depolarization detectable at 6 h
tau_2: oxidative DNA damage / dopamine loss / p-Tau complex at 24 h
tau_3: chronic neurodegeneration risk (dementia up to four-fold after moderate-severe TBI, p73)

layer2.mapping: Dose-regime bifurcation operator: the SAME mechanical input channel produces qualitatively different system fates depending on amplitude (adaptive remodeling vs sublethal stress cascade vs lethal failure). Isomorphic to head-impact dose regimes in the 22-player collision system: sub-threshold loading -> benign adaptation; intermediate loading -> sub-concussive cascade (the 25%/1 Hz analog: measurable biomarker rise without gross failure); high loading -> structural failure. Binding constraint: return-to-play and contact-load decisions must be made on the regime map, not on the absence of immediate symptoms - the 24 h biomarker latency in the source is the analog of delayed concussion signs.
layer2.telemetry: Printed: strain 5/25/50%, 1 Hz, 6/24 h; JC-1 red/green fluorescence (ex/em 535/590 vs 475/530, p75); 8-OHdG immunoreactivity; LDH release; alignment angle +/-30 deg. Football-side calibrating observables (not fabricated values): instrumented head-impact linear/angular acceleration distributions, symptom-onset latency, serum tau (source notes Olympic boxers show elevated plasma tau after mild head trauma, p73 citing Neselius 2013).

primitives.name: MitoQ potential-driven mitochondrial targeting: TPP+ lipophilic cation accumulation at the inner membrane
primitives.verbatim_quote: It is synthesized by conjugating a ubiquinone moiety to a triphenylphosphonium cation (TPP+) [17]. TPP+ is a lipophilic cation that directs the ubiquinone moiety to the inner mitochondrial mem- brane (IMM) and enables its accumulation due to the high electrochemical potential [18]. Accumulated MitoQ in the IMM is reduced by complex II into its antioxidative quinol form [19]
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: [TPP+]_matrix / [TPP+]_cytosol = concentration ratio of the lipophilic cation across the inner mitochondrial membrane (dimensionless); F = Faraday constant 96485 C/mol; Delta psi_m = magnitude of the mitochondrial membrane potential (V; matrix negative, cation accumulates down the electrical gradient); R = gas constant 8.314 J/(mol K); T = absolute temperature (K). Exponent F*Delta psi_m/(R*T) is dimensionless (C/mol * V / (J/(mol K) * K) = J/mol / J/mol). At 310 K, RT/F ~ 26.7 mV, i.e. ~10-fold accumulation per ~61.5 mV (ln(10)*RT/F). Nernst equation is DERIVED standard electrochemistry applied to the printed mechanism - the source states accumulation 'due to the high electrochemical potential' but prints no equation and no potential value.
primitives.assumptions: Printed (Haidar et al., Biomedicines 2022, 10, 250, reprint p347): MitoQ = ubiquinone moiety conjugated to triphenylphosphonium cation (TPP+); TPP+ is lipophilic and directs the moiety to the inner mitochondrial membrane (IMM), accumulating due to the high electrochemical potential; accumulated MitoQ is reduced by complex II to the antioxidative quinol form; molecules entering mitochondria adsorb to the IMM matrix surface and are constantly recycled; MitoQ crosses the BBB and acts via Nrf2-ARE. Derived-kernel assumptions: Nernstian equilibrium for a monovalent permeant cation, no binding saturation, potential maintained. Dose context printed: 8 mg/kg IP, 3x/week, 30 days, first dose 30 min post-CCI (p348); 2 mg/kg was ineffective in the cited prior study (p362).
primitives.breakdown_regime: Self-limiting delivery paradox (cross-chapter synthesis, labeled): the targeting gradient is the very quantity the pathology destroys. Stretch injury collapses MMP (JC-1 green/red up, ch04 pp75-76); as Delta psi_m -> 0 the Nernst ratio -> 1 and mitochondria-targeted accumulation vanishes precisely in the damaged organelles that need the antioxidant. Additional breakdowns: (a) binding/adsorption saturation at the IMM matrix face violates the free-concentration Nernst assumption (source itself notes adsorption and recycling); (b) quinol recycling can shift redox balance at high loads - source cites 28-week safety data in wild-type mice (p362) but that is an empirical guard, not a mechanistic guarantee; (c) depolarized mitochondria also impair complex II reduction of MitoQ to its active quinol form. The kernel is therefore state-dependent: K(delivery | Delta psi_m), not a constant bioavailability factor.
timescales: tau_1: complex II reduction to quinol and recycling (continuous)
tau_2: dosing cycle 3x/week starting 30 min post-injury (p348)
tau_3: chronic 30-day treatment window with behavioral gains at 7 and 30 DPI (p352)

layer2.mapping: State-dependent delivery kernel: intervention concentration at the target = input dose times exp(F*Delta psi/RT), i.e. efficacy is gated by the target's own state variable. Derived from the printed TPP+ mechanism via Nernst. In the 22-player system this is the kernel for any state-gated intervention: a corrective scheme or substitution only accumulates where the unit's execution potential is intact; installing a fix into a collapsed unit (fatigued, confused, out of position) yields ratio ~ 1 - the intervention reaches the roster but not the target. Binding constraint: assess the gradient (unit readiness) before committing the intervention dose.
layer2.telemetry: Printed calibrators: JC-1 red(polarized)/green(depolarized) ratio, ex/em 535/590 vs 475/530 (ch04 p75); MitoQ 8 mg/kg effective vs 2 mg/kg ineffective (p362); Garcia neuroscore gains at 7 and 30 DPI but not day 3 (p352); Nrf2/SOD2/CAT mRNA up at 30 DPI (pp355-356). Football-side observables (no fabricated values): readiness/fatigue proxies gating practice-install effectiveness; delivery lag between install and execution.

primitives.name: Canonical-probe blindness: isoform-resolved assay detects what the canonical-only assay misses (miR-146a)
primitives.verbatim_quote: Next, we performed RT-qPCR to detect all 3′ end isomiRs (Figure 7D, FC = 1.7, p < 0.05) and were able to detect a difference between the controls and post-TBI animals. Quantitative RT-PCR and primer assay targeting only canonical miR-146a was not able to detect this increase (see Supplementary Figure S3, FC = 1.4, p > 0.05).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: S_total = total reads aligned to the miRNA locus (dimensionless count); S_canonical = reads matching the miRBase canonical sequence (count); S_isomiR,j = reads of the j-th isoform variant (count); FC = fold change TBI/sham (dimensionless ratio); p = probability under the null (dimensionless, Mann-Whitney U as printed p99). Printed values: canonical-only RT-qPCR FC=1.4 (p>0.05, not significant) vs 3'-end-isomiR-detecting RT-qPCR FC=1.7 (p<0.05); canonical miR-146a fraction of aligned reads 37.71% (SD 8.56) in TBI vs 48.32% (SD 9.33) in sham (p105); isomiR retention threshold 5% of locus reads (p95).
primitives.assumptions: Printed (Puhakka et al., reprint pp95, 105): the canonical sequence is only one member of the locus's read distribution; 3' nucleotide additions (A/U) are common and can change folding (linear miR-146a predicted to become hairpin-like with 3' insertions, p105); a primer assay targeting only the canonical sequence is a projection onto one coordinate of that distribution; the isomiR-detecting chemistry sums the 3'-variant family. n=6 TBI vs 6 sham, same samples as sequencing. The decomposition S_total = S_canonical + sum S_isomiR is a formalization of the printed read-count accounting, labeled as such.
primitives.breakdown_regime: The canonical-only probe fails exactly when the biology lives in the isoform tail: here the canonical fraction DROPS (48.32% -> 37.71%) while total-locus signal rises, so a canonical-coordinate measurement can even move opposite to the functional change. Breakdowns of the isoform assay itself: (a) 3' additions can alter Argonaute loading and targeting efficiency, so summed counts are not a single functional quantity (source: 'very diverse and contradictory functions are attributed to these addition events', p111); (b) low-abundance miRNAs (miR-155-5p) yield no detected isomiRs and drop out of the analysis (p97); (c) the 5% retention threshold censors rare variants; (d) predicted folding changes are in-silico (RNAfold), not measured structures.
timescales: tau_3: behavioral-outcome coupling (neuroscore Spearman r=0.75 full miR-146a profile, p109)

layer2.mapping: Lossy-projection / measurement-aliasing operator: the canonical-only assay is a projection pi from the isoform distribution onto one coordinate; any effect lying in the complement of that coordinate is invisible, and the projected statistic can move opposite to the full signal. Isomorphic to canonical-stat scouting in the 22-player system: a single headline statistic (the canonical sequence of a player) is a projection of a distribution of scheme-dependent behaviors; an effect concentrated in the tail (specific down/distance, pressure, coverage shell) is aliased away, and the headline can even trend opposite to the functional reality. Binding constraint: choose the measurement coordinate to span where the effect lives, or report the projection as lossy.
layer2.telemetry: Printed: FC 1.4 (ns) vs 1.7 (p<0.05); canonical fraction 37.71% vs 48.32%; 3' isomiRs TGAGAACTGAATTCCATGGGT and TGAGAACTGAATTCCATGGGTT significantly more abundant in TBI (p105); full-profile miR-146a correlates with worse 3-month neuroscore (Spearman r=0.75, p<0.001, p109). Football-side observables (no fabricated values): distributional split stats vs headline aggregates; projection-loss audit comparing coordinate choice to effect location.

reasoning_traces.think: Reading this reprint as a dynamical-systems document rather than a clinical catalog, the first sovereign fact is that traumatic brain injury is not an event but a cascade with amplification. The Jarrahi review (reprint pp29-71) separates primary mechanical insult from secondary injury, and the secondary phase is where the mathematics lives: mechanical stretch opens micropores, sodium floods in, Na+/K+ ATPases fail as ATP collapses, depolarization dumps glutamate, NMDAR overactivation admits calcium, and calcium recruits proteases and radical chemistry (p33). Each step recruits the next; the system has positive feedback built into its ion gradients. The lipid peroxidation chain on p41 is the cleanest formal instance: AA + R• -> AA• + RH initiates, AA• + O2 -> AAOO• propagates, and AAOO• + AA -> AAOH + AA• regenerates the radical. One initiation event therefore damages many lipid molecules before termination; the chain length nu = propagation rate over initiation rate is the amplification factor. I deliberately keep nu symbolic because the source prints mechanism, not rate constants; assigning numeric k values from memory would launder external numbers into a source-anchored artifact. The same review supplies the termination side: GSH, SOD, CAT, GPx, the Nrf2-ARE inducible program (pp38, 42). The invariant is a race between initiation and termination capacity, and the clinical history in the review is exactly what happens when you lose that race at scale: PEG-SOD phase II succeeded with administration at 4 h post-injury while phase III failed at 8 h (p39), and NOS inhibitors protected only within one hour (p40). The therapeutic window is not a pharmacological footnote; it is the time constant of the cascade. An antioxidant that arrives after the chain has consumed its substrate budget cannot show effect, which is why the review insists on the 4-h difference between the two PEG-SOD trials. The Cheng stretch chapter (pp72-88) then gives the dose axis of the same cascade. Strain is the control parameter: 5% elongation supports survival and even enhances synaptic-vesicle velocity, 25% at 1 Hz for 6-24 h produces a sublethal stress phenotype (MMP depolarization at 6 h, 8-OHdG DNA damage and dopamine loss at 24 h, BDNF down, amyloid-beta and p-TauS396 up, GSK-3beta-tau complex formation), and 50% releases LDH and kills cells (p73). This is a regime map, not a linear dose-response: the same input channel produces adaptation, chronic stress, or death depending on amplitude. Two honesty flags belong in the record. First, the 5% and 50% anchors are cited prior work, not measurements of this paper. Second, the paper contradicts itself on geometry: Methods says biaxial stretch (p74), Results says uniaxial (pp75-79). Uniaxial and biaxial strain states are different stress tensors, so the effective dose is ambiguous; I extract the regime structure and flag the inconsistency rather than silently averaging it away. The authors' own limitation - proliferative SH-SY5Y cells are not terminally differentiated neurons (p84) - further bounds transfer. The MitoQ chapter (pp345-368) supplies the intervention side and the deepest structural insight of the book. MitoQ is ubiquinone conjugated to a lipophilic triphenylphosphonium cation; the cation accumulates at the inner mitochondrial membrane because of the electrochemical potential (p347). Formalizing that statement with the Nernst relation gives a concentration ratio exp(F*Delta psi/RT), roughly tenfold per 61.5 mV at body temperature - a derived kernel, explicitly labeled, since the source prints no equation. The paradox emerges when the chapters are read against each other: the stretch chapter shows injury depolarizes mitochondria (JC-1 green/red rises), and the Nernst kernel says accumulation collapses as the potential collapses. The delivery mechanism is gated by the very state variable the disease destroys. This is not a defect of MitoQ alone; it is a structural property of any state-dependent targeting scheme, and it explains why the effective dose in the cited prior work was 8 mg/kg while 2 mg/kg did nothing (p362), and why behavioral gains in the present study appear at 7 and 30 days but not day 3 (p352): the chronic window is where surviving, still-polarized mitochondria can be rescued and the inflammatory loop dampened. Connecting the three primitives yields one coherent operator picture of secondary injury: a strain-dose sets the regime (p3), the regime ignites chain-amplified damage (p1), and any repair intervention carries a state-dependent delivery kernel (p4). The football translation is an isomorphism of structure, not a fabricated origin: a defense is also a cascade system where one broken assignment propagates through adjacent defenders until a termination event, where load regimes separate adaptation from injury, and where a corrective install only takes hold in units whose execution potential is intact. The calibration discipline is identical on both sides: measure the amplification ratio, the regime boundaries, and the delivery gradient before claiming an intervention effect. The book's own translational failures - CRASH corticosteroids increasing mortality (p45), progesterone phase III null (p50), more than 30 failed phase III trials in three decades (p346) - are the empirical scar tissue proving that single-target, late-arriving, state-blind interventions lose to cascades. That is the durable lesson this artifact carries forward: cascades are beaten by termination capacity and timing, not by stronger single pushes.
reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: The hidden state of this literature was created by specific historical scars. Harman's 1956 free-radical theory of aging (cited at reprint p267) established oxidative damage as a cumulative, chain-chemical process, which is why the TBI field inherited radical scavenging as its first therapeutic instinct. Then the trial failures accumulated: CRASH showed corticosteroids increased mortality (p45), progesterone and PEG-SOD phase III trials failed (pp39, 50), and NMDAR antagonists were halted for side effects and narrow windows (p34). Each failure selected the field's next belief: move from single acute targets to chronic, multi-pathway, mitochondria-directed windows. The MitoQ chronic-dosing design and the tRF chronic 3-month signature are descendants of that selection pressure, not independent inventions. The lineage explains why this reprint emphasizes timing, state-dependence, and endogenous defense (Nrf2) over brute-force receptor blockade.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: Belief clash under pressure is visible at three levels. The clinician's comfort call is stabilization: control ICP, prevent seizures, discharge on symptom absence - a policy optimized for the observable acute state. The molecular researcher's belief is that the real game is the invisible secondary cascade, so symptom absence is not clearance; the 24-h biomarker latency in the stretch model is her evidence. The trialist's belief is enrollment feasibility, which pushes toward GCS-only criteria that the review itself criticizes (p51). Recursive modeling: the clinician knows the researcher will demand biomarkers, the researcher knows the trialist will dilute the cohort, and the trialist knows both will blame a null result on the other's compromise. The football analog is exact: the coach's comfort call (run the base scheme), the DC's tendency trap (the offense is baiting that comfort), and the QB's internal clock (progression timing that fails if the protection cascade breaks). Each agent's locally rational belief is globally fragile when the cascade is ignored.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Cross-layer veto adjudication: physics vetoes the high-EV symptom-free clearance. A player or patient who looks normal at hour 2 can sit in the sublethal strain regime where MMP depolarization and DNA damage are still accumulating (6-24 h latency, pp75-76); the regime map therefore vetoes any decision rule keyed only to immediate symptoms. The delivery kernel adds a second veto: an antioxidant intervention aimed at depolarized mitochondria has Nernst ratio near 1, so the projected benefit of late, low-dose scavenging is physically inflated; the 4-h versus 8-h PEG-SOD contrast (p39) is the empirical veto record. Psychology adds the third: the clinician's comfort belief in observable stability is exactly the bias the cascade punishes. The adjudicated rule: clearance and intervention decisions must condition on regime biomarkers and arrival delay, and any high-EV call that ignores them is vetoed regardless of its apparent expected value.

reasoning_traces.think: The second sovereign theme of this reprint is that measurement is not a window but a construction, and the construction can fail in structured, predictable ways. Three independent instances in the book form a single operator family. Instance one is the ddPCR normalization pipeline (pp96-97). Droplet digital PCR returns absolute copy numbers, but the raw count per well still carries two nuisance scales: how much RNA went into the cDNA reaction, and how efficiently the sample was processed. The printed pipeline removes them in two quotients: first divide average copies per 20 uL well by the total RNA input to the 15 uL cDNA reaction (computed from NanoDrop concentration and the 1:100 dilution), then divide by the geometric mean of four endogenous controls (miR-378a-3p, miR-3594-3p, miR-330-5p, let-7b-3p). Algebraically this is a projection onto a quotient space: each sample carries an unknown positive multiplicative factor s, the observable is s times the true abundance, and dividing by invariant references makes s act trivially. The geometric mean is the correct aggregator because the nuisance is multiplicative and approximately log-normal; an arithmetic mean would let one high-count control dominate. The same paper runs the identical construction at sequencing scale with TMM normalization (p95) and at qPCR scale with 2^-DeltaCt (p97, Livak-Schmittgen lineage). Recognizing all three as one gauge-fixing operator is the extraction's value: the invariant is not the miRNA biology but the normalization structure, and it transfers to any rate statistic where opportunity volume is the nuisance scale. The breakdown is equally structural: if a reference is itself regulated, the quotient injects the biology it was supposed to remove. The book guards this with RIN 8.9-9.2 and 260/280 ratios 2.01-2.10 (p94) and by selecting controls from non-differential sequencing results - but the guard is an assumption, not a theorem. Instance two is canonical-probe blindness (p105), the most elegant measurement failure in the book. The miR-146a locus produces a distribution of isoforms; the canonical miRBase sequence is one coordinate of that distribution. After TBI the canonical fraction of aligned reads falls from 48.32% to 37.71% while 3'-added isomiRs rise. A primer assay targeting only the canonical sequence reports FC=1.4, p>0.05 - nothing. An assay detecting all 3'-end isomiRs reports FC=1.7, p<0.05 - a real effect. The canonical assay is a lossy projection pi onto one coordinate; the effect lives in the complement, so the projection is not merely noisy but systematically blind, and can even trend opposite to the full signal because the canonical share shrinks while the locus total grows. The functional consequence is not cosmetic: the full miR-146a profile (canonical plus all isomiRs) correlates with worse 3-month neuroscore at Spearman r=0.75 (p109), and the 3'tRFs correlate even more strongly (r=0.78 and r=0.92). A research program that had trusted the canonical-only assay would have discarded miR-146a as unchanged and never reached the behavioral coupling. The measurement choice determined which biology was discoverable. The source also bounds the isoform assay itself: 3' additions have 'diverse and contradictory functions' (p111), low-abundance miR-155-5p yields no isomiRs and drops out (p97), and the 5% retention threshold (p95) censors rare variants - so the summed isoform count is a better coordinate, not a final truth. Instance three is the loading-control hazard in the Yoshida chapter (p268). Mitochondrial Western blots are normalized to COX-IV, but the authors explicitly warn that COX-IV may itself be damaged in AD transgenic mice, so the denominator of the normalization is condition-dependent. This is instance one's breakdown realized in print: when the reference frame is damaged by the disease, every normalized ratio inherits a spurious shift. The authors recommend multiple loading proteins - a direct admission that a single gauge is unsafe when the gauge itself is a state variable. The hippocampal findings (SOD-2 down, 3-NT up, NMNAT-3 down, NQO-1 collapsing between 3 and 6 months while cortical NQO-1 stays elevated) are therefore extracted with the normalization caveat attached, not as raw truth. Synthesizing: the book's measurement doctrine is (1) choose references that are invariant under the condition, (2) aggregate multiplicatively with geometric means, (3) choose the measurement coordinate to span where the effect lives, and (4) audit whether the reference itself is a state variable. The football isomorphism is immediate and non-fabricated: headline stats are canonical projections of scheme-dependent behavior distributions; per-snap and per-possession rates are gauge-fixing quotients; and a scouting reference (a baseline opponent, a replacement-level comparator) that is itself affected by the scheme being studied reproduces the COX-IV hazard exactly. The deception layer follows: an opponent who knows you scout the canonical coordinate can present a canonical profile that hides the isoform tail - the statistical analog of showing a base formation while the effect lives in the motion split. The durable invariant is that every comparison carries a gauge, every gauge can be captured by the condition, and every projection can be gamed; the audit is to name the gauge, test its invariance, and locate the effect before trusting the number.
reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: The genealogy of these measurement conventions is traceable in the book's own references. The 2^-DeltaDeltaCt method comes from Livak and Schmittgen 2001 (ref 38, p114), which standardized relative qPCR on single reference genes - a convention born when multiplexing was expensive. The isomiR awareness descends from Burroughs et al. 2010's survey of 3' animal miRNA modifications (ref 16, p114), which showed canonical miRBase entries are only a fraction of expressed molecules; the canonical-only primer habit is a scar of database-era thinking, where the catalog entry was mistaken for the molecule. ddPCR's absolute counts and geometric-mean multi-reference normalization emerged as corrections to both scars. The hidden state is thus a stack of historical workarounds, each solving the previous generation's measurement failure, and each carrying its own breakdown regime forward.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The belief clash here is between the assay designer, the biologist, and the statistician. The assay designer believes the canonical sequence IS the target - a belief inherited from the miRBase catalog - and designs primers to it. The biologist believes the functional entity is the isoform distribution, because 3' additions change folding and Argonaute association (p105, p111). The statistician believes any comparison is only as good as its reference invariance, and watches the COX-IV warning (p268) with alarm. Recursive modeling: the designer knows the biologist will question probe coverage, the biologist knows the statistician will question the denominator, and the statistician knows both will defend their choices because re-running assays is expensive. The football analog: the scout who trusts the headline stat (canonical probe), the coordinator who lives in the split distributions (isoforms), and the analyst who knows the baseline comparator is scheme-contaminated (COX-IV). Under pressure each defaults to their trained coordinate, and the organization's discovery rate is set by whose coordinate wins the budget argument.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Cross-layer veto: the measurement layer vetoes biological conclusions before biology gets a vote. The canonical-only miR-146a result (FC=1.4, p>0.05) would have vetoed downstream target analysis and the behavioral correlation - a false negative manufactured by probe choice, not by biology (p105). The COX-IV hazard vetoes naive interpretation of every mitochondrial Western ratio in the AD chapter, because the denominator is condition-dependent (p268); the authors' own caveat is the veto record. In football terms the same veto fires when a scouting conclusion rests on a headline stat whose opportunity denominator is scheme-driven, or on a baseline opponent that the studied scheme itself distorts: the high-EV game-plan call built on that number is vetoed by the measurement layer regardless of its apparent edge. Adjudicated rule: no downstream decision may outrun the invariance audit of its measurement coordinate and reference frame.

universal_lens: Polymath audit lens extracted from this reprint: every cascade carries an amplification factor (radical chain length), every measurement carries a gauge choice (RNA-input and geometric-mean reference quotients; canonical vs isoform projection), and every targeted delivery carries a state-dependence (Nernstian accumulation gated by the very gradient the disease destroys). Audit any claim by asking three questions: what is the chain length between trigger and damage, what reference frame makes the comparison invariant, and does the intervention's delivery collapse in the state it is meant to treat? These three gates transfer unchanged across biochemistry, biophysics, and football dynamical systems.
